explication: RTK is a Rust CLI proxy that rewrites supported shell commands, runs command-specific filters, and returns compact output to an AI agent. Its main workflow is complemented by agent hook installation, command discovery and learning, savings analytics, and recall storage. README statements establish the user-facing flow; source-index references support selected internal links. Many command handlers and subsystem implementations were not sampled, so their internal call paths are not inferred.
